name: Gutsy Flux
source:
Sofía and Manda trek through an unfamiliar world, where each door leads them through a seemingly endless maze of rooms. New oddities await behind every doorway: baffling environments, eccentric denizens, maybe even an elusive clue about this mysterious place. With so much to explore around every corner, will they ever manage to find an exit?

[From [url=https://lynslayer.itch.io/gutsy-flux-ep1]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
索菲亚和曼达跋涉穿过一个陌生的世界，每扇门都引导他们穿过看似无尽的房间迷宫。每个门口后面都有新的奇怪现象等待着：令人困惑的环境、古怪的居民，甚至可能是关于这个神秘地方的难以捉摸的线索。每个角落都有那么多值得探索的地方，他们能找到出口吗？

[来自[url=https://lynslayer.itch.io/gutsy-flux-ep1]itch.io[/url]]
